summary.text: Roman Gaskey is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 54, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Sarah Pounds for a seat with no incumbent. He is a strategy and data analyst at a technology startup.

paragraphs.text: Roman Gaskey said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he is a lifelong Oakland County resident who attended Lake Orion Community Schools and graduated as valedictorian in 2021.
He said he earned a Bachelor of Science in mathematics and data science from the University of Michigan.

He said he works as a strategy and data analyst for a technology startup that develops technology to reduce the cost of legal services, and that he serves on the economic vitality committee of a downtown development authority.
Gaskey advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.

In the survey, he listed the cost of living, including housing, energy and health care costs, as a main campaign message, along with urgency in addressing problems and respect for the constitutional role of state and local government.
